level_id_bank.verdict: ARCHETYPE = a failed advance inside a long unwind. The reclaim trigger is ZONE 1 -- a DAILY CLOSE ABOVE 40.60 clears the cluster there; absent that, the 1H MA knot around 37.5-38.2 is session-scale support only and the structure stays corrective.
level_id_bank.method: TWO ladders of DIFFERENT KINDS. R = REVERSE level-ID (0 = swing HIGH 71.50 -> 1 = swing LOW 39.67, extensions project DOWN), verified to 0.00. S = a STANDARD Fibonacci retracement/extension preset (0.236/0.382/0.5/0.618/0.786 + 1.618/2.618/3.618/4.236), verified to 0.01 -- the 4.236 ratio is the tell, since it is NOT in the level-ID set, so S is a second STYLE and is tagged as such. Box edges measured from an 8-point least-squares pixel->price fit on the 1D (residual <=0.03), cross-checked on the weekly.
